cards.card_text: He tells David they raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah and the Negev of Caleb, and "we burned down Ziklag." WE, friend, and he's telling that to the man who LIVES in Ziklag.
cards.verse_text: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned down Ziklag.”
cards.snippet: We raided the Negev of the Cherethites, the territory of Judah, and the Negev of Caleb, and we burned…

cards.card_text: The king stops at the last house while all his servants march past him: the Cherethites and Pelethites, men under David's command, plus six hundred Gittites who followed him from Gath.
cards.verse_text: He stopped at the last house, and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.
cards.snippet: …at the last house, and all his servants marched past him—all the Cherethites and Pelethites, and six hundred Gittites who had followed him from Gath.

cards.card_text: Out of Jerusalem they march: Joab's men, the Cherethites, the Pelethites and ALL the mighty men.
cards.verse_text: So Joab’s men, along with the Cherethites, the Pelethites, and all the mighty men, marched out of Jerusalem in pursuit of Sheba son of Bichri.

cards.card_text: So Zadok, Nathan and Benaiah, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, set Solomon on King David's mule.
cards.verse_text: Then Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, went down and set Solomon on King David’s mule, and they escorted him to Gihon.

cards.verse_text: therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I will stretch out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.
cards.snippet: …out My hand against the Philistines, and I will cut off the Cherethites and destroy the remnant along the coast.

cards.card_text: Then comes a “Woe” for the dwellers of the seacoast, the nation of the Cherethites, and the word of the LORD is against Canaan.
cards.verse_text: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites!
cards.snippet: Woe to the dwellers of the seacoast, O nation of the Cherethites!
